title: Base Language Models
summary: This module defines the foundational interfaces for interacting with various language models, including abstract base classes for LLMs and chat models, enabling consistent integration and extensibility.

nodes.label: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language model wrappers, providing common functionalities like caching, verbosity, callbacks, and token counting.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: Large Language Model (LLM)
nodes.description: A simplified interface for implementing custom Large Language Models, focusing on text generation and providing methods for synchronous and asynchronous calls.

nodes.label: SimpleChatModel
nodes.title: Simple Chat Model
nodes.description: A simplified implementation for chat models, primarily for backward compatibility, allowing basic chat interactions.

nodes.label: CallbackManagerForLLMRun
nodes.title: Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages callbacks during LLM runs, allowing for custom actions like logging or streaming.

nodes.label: AsyncCallbackManagerForLLMRun
nodes.title: Async Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous callbacks during LLM runs, enabling non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: RetryCallState
nodes.title: Retry Call State
nodes.description: Represents the state of a retried function call, used for handling retries and logging.

nodes.label: _before_sleep
nodes.title: Before Sleep Hook
nodes.description: A utility function executed before a retry sleep, handling logging and callback invocation for both synchronous and asynchronous contexts.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Language Model Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the fundamental abstract base classes for all language models and chat models, establishing common properties and methods.

groups.label: Utility Functions
groups.title: Utility and Helper Functions
groups.description: Contains helper functions for retry mechanisms and callback handling within the language model operations.
